descRegionV0: {location} is one of the most popular yacht charter hubs in {country} — a launching point for exploring hidden coves, sun-drenched islands and UNESCO-listed coastal towns. faqBaseA1: The home port of {name} is {location} in {country} — you board there on check-in day and return the boat to the same berth.

faqLicenceQ: Do I need a licence to charter {name}?
faqLicenceBareboatA0: Yes — for a bareboat charter of {name} the skipper needs a valid sailing licence and, in most countries, a VHF radio certificate. If nobody in your crew holds one, you can add a professional skipper to the booking instead.
faqLicenceBareboatA1: To take {name} out bareboat, at least one person aboard must hold a recognised skipper licence (plus a VHF certificate where required). No licence in the crew? Book her with a professional skipper and cruise the same route.
faqLicenceBareboatA2: A valid nautical licence is required to skipper {name} yourself; local rules usually ask for a VHF certificate as well. Hiring a licensed skipper through us removes the requirement entirely.
faqLicenceCrewedA0: No licence is needed — {name} comes with professional crew, so you and your guests simply step aboard and enjoy the trip.
faqLicenceCrewedA1: You don’t need any sailing qualifications for {name}: the professional crew handles navigation, manoeuvres and safety throughout the charter.
faqPriceQ: How much does it cost to charter {name}?
faqPriceA0: Weekly charter rates for {name} start from {price}, depending on the season — early summer and September weeks are usually the best value. Check the availability calendar for exact prices per date.
faqPriceA1: Prices for {name} begin at {price} per week in the lower season and rise towards the July–August peak. The calendar on this page shows the live rate for every available week.
faqPriceA2: You can charter {name} from {price} for a week, with the exact rate set by the departure date — the on-page calendar always shows current, bookable prices.
faqCheckinQ: What are the check-in and check-out times for {name}?
faqCheckinA0: Check-in aboard {name} is from {checkin} on the first day and check-out is by {checkout} on the last — standard turnaround times that give the base crew time to prepare the boat.
faqCheckinA1: You board {name} at {checkin} on departure day and hand her back by {checkout} at the end of the charter; earlier boarding can sometimes be arranged with the base directly.
faqCheckinA2: The charter day runs from {checkin} check-in to {checkout} check-out on the final morning — plan your arrival and homeward travel around those times.
faqBookA0: Pick your dates in the availability calendar, review the total price and confirm online — {name} is reserved for you the moment the booking is placed, with transparent pricing and no hidden fees.
faqBookA1: Booking {name} takes a few minutes: choose a free week in the calendar, check the price breakdown and complete the secure online checkout. Our team confirms every detail with the operator for you.
faqBookA2: Select an available period for {name}, submit the online booking and you’ll receive confirmation with all charter documents — payment is split into instalments and the price you see is final.
faqBookInquiryA: {name} has no dates or prices published online at the moment, so it is booked by inquiry: send us your preferred dates using the form on this page and our team will check availability and the price for you and reply by e-mail.
